sections.name: Red Wines
items: Sonoma County 2018. A sharp and full-bodied cab, with notes of banana and wishniak cherries.
Mendoza, Argentina 2019. Full-bodied, peppery and oaky, this wine will not disappoint!
Oregon 2019. A slightly smokey red with hints of cherry that should please any wine drinker!
Francis Ford Coppola Claret Bordeaux Red Blend
Diamond Collection, California 2018. Velvety and sophisticated, with hints of dark cherry and chocolate.
Columbia Valley, Washington 2017. You like a jammy wine? Here's a jammy wine. Overripe fruit and preserves abound.
Vintner's Collection, Napa Valley 2014. An expressive and inviting red wine that's full of flavor and character.
Vintner's Collection, Napa Valley 2015. Rich black fruit flavors mix with hints of toffee and chocolate from the toasty oak.
Vintner's Collection, Central Coast 2014. Perfect for those who enjoy demure, yet flavorful, red wines. Best paired with pork.

sections.name: White Wines
items: Marlborough, New Zealand 2019. A well-balanced dry rose with fresh strawberries, mandarin and a hint of cranberry.
Sonoma County 2018. Lightly oaked and fruit-forward, great with a hearty salad or our fish and chips.
Pfalz, Germany 2018. Juicy apple, melon and citrus aromas with a subtle, drying finish
Rosso & Bianco 2015. A light, refreshing white wine that's versatile enough for any occasion.
Marlborough 2015. Zesty and aromatic. Always crisp, elegant and refreshing.
Vintner's Collection 2014. Vibrant fruit and supple texture, perfect poise for any occasion.
California 2015. Semi-dry zinfandel with fresh red berry, citrus and melon aromas.
